structural_change: S81-LINK5-L5B-XGXO (10-21): ot_s81sl_xg_xo = ot_s81sl_xg with ring stop ot_s81sl_rstop_xo (head XB egress at sid 1 = s_0N -> ro_w, S81-RTLGAP/head 589110357, TOK.DS.BENCH.4.1). NO port change: kit = clone of s81sl_xg (claude/s81-xg-1019 f3c425683) outline/pins/macros, new sources only. Replaces ot_s81sl_xg as u_sl.u_xg in the 4 MU72 end parents (G5 UNBOUND). Prior s81sl_xg history: S81-XG (10-19): new hardened gather sub-leaf of the S81 slice centre (C1 / C3 master child u_xg, 16 per die): ring stop data plane ot_s81sl_rstop (tier line E/W 1,104 b, V rung 276 b, NX snake ends, sid = 2*col + tier decode from S81-LBGAP G2 1b7c4b828) + x streamer ot_s81sl_xs (kit s81sl_xs floorplan v2 of 1dcaa1b20, never routed). The rstop -> xs gather port (3 x 1,031 b a cycle) stays internal. Floorplan: per-source x-buffer bank columns facing their ring faces (bank 1 = from W at x 86.4, bank 0 = own / V at 216, bank 2 = from E at 432), the 7 ROMs abutted in one column at 345.6 between bank 0 and bank 2 (calendar / phase / stream control in the middle), std-cell ring around the macros for the face pin-flop bands; clock + reset at the S-face centre. Same RTL cycles as the slice benches; reset landed at the face (2 stages, ROOT-RST). Gate1 (10-19, ot-agidock128) died at macro placement: the ROOT-RST landing-only wrapper (pin_regs off + reset_landing on) renames the core u_ot_pr_core, so the spec's u_s.* instance names matched nothing -> instance patterns are globs '*u_s.g_bank?b?.g_mac?m?.u_mem' / '*u_s.u_<rom>' (match with or without the wrapper).
